text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик trains hard in preparation
for the
Sumire Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She vows to win three races in the
Classics just to
make me smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With that goal in mind, she continues to
secretly
put in extra effort to further her
abilities.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
